generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall emergent spreading by rhizomes into dense stands, with long, flat, strap-shaped leaves sheathing a stout stem topped by a dense brown sausage of female flowers. Redone on the sedge program as a clonal stand (plant forms F6). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: grey-green leaves; dark brown spikes.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
